result.summary: The tenth trigger search was performed over a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven, eight, and nine. Component (a) (normal-form computation for triangular structures) performed bounded network retrieval via the arXiv export API over Lazard regular chains, Ritt-Kalkbrener normal forms, shape-lemma theory, and sparse Groebner-basis bounds; literal-term queries for 'Lazard'+'regular chain', 'regular chains'+'normal form', 'Ritt-Kalkbrener', 'normal form'+'triangular set', and 'sparse Groebner basis' each returned zero results, while broader queries retrieved regular-chain normal-form/GCD algorithms (Li-Moreno Maza-Pan; Chen-Moreno Maza), a Shape Lemma/subresultant-generation relation theorem (Cox-D'Andrea) with a roots-requiring Poisson formula, a triangular-decomposition complexity bound (singly exponential; Chen-Davenport-May-Moreno Maza-Xia-Xiao) plus a withdrawn related paper (Tang-Xia), and two off-target results (real CAD via regular chains; a noncommutative shape lemma for differential operators). Every on-target candidate computes a normal form, GCD, or resultant/subresultant generating set modulo an ALREADY-GIVEN polynomial system, ideal, or root set, never deriving r_R from E, P, Q without first materializing the P1553 system; each is the same already-costed basis/quotient-ring or resultant/subresultant category the eight frozen H-CREP-001 routes and round nine's candidates already occupy. Component (b) (deck-local mixed-radix identity search) performed an internal-structure analysis of the two frozen P1553 mixed-radix correction packets plus targeted retrieval (one relevant but off-domain hit: Hines, arXiv:2206.07412), and establishes a named structural obstruction for each of the three requested avenues: the frozen group has PRIME order N, so no Chinese Remainder decomposition (which requires a composite modulus) is available; g_I's label polynomial ring and the deck's integer radix m are never bridged by any map in the frozen records; and the frozen interface is stated entirely additively, with no pairing or multiplicative-group structure defined anywhere. The internal-corpus resource-check answer is examined true, none found, for both components. Every candidate considered (C1-C8) is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); none passes every item. The honest disposition is scoped_no_candidate.

The coordinate-aware P1553 target-local remainder transducer and the exact dyadic subinterval unit-product interface remain open under their exact narrow boundaries, as does every broader preserved route, including normal-form computation for triangular structures beyond the already-given-chain formulations searched this round, and any future mixed-radix correction with a composite auxiliary modulus or an explicit pairing/multiplicative embedding (the method-ceiling composite-order control in proof-search-map.yaml records that such a correction would plausibly admit a genuine CRT-componentwise recurrence, localizing this round's obstruction to the frozen prime-N premise rather than generalizing it).
